v1_policy: retain schema, adapter, and receipts unchanged for historical v1 tables

container.logical_bytes_formula: 8*T + 4*P + 45*T*P; reject before reading dataset values if above the uncompressed-byte cap
container.stream_reading: verify one time row and at most 65536 particles per dataset chunk; never load a whole trajectory dataset
container.root_objects: exactly the registered datasets below; every link is hard, each link resolves to a distinct dataset, and no group or other HDF5 object is allowed
container.particle_dataset_chunking: exactly (1,min(P,65536),3) for vectors and (1,min(P,65536)) for scalars; exactly one complete chunk per time row is allocated; LZF is the only filter; shuffle=false, fletcher32=false, scaleoffset=null
container.time_and_id_layout: contiguous, uncompressed, and allocated storage equals the full logical dataset size

fixed_values.trajectory_semantics: native numerical SPH particle identity; fluid cohort only; not material identity

root_attributes.case_id_source: the exact case_id shared by the frozen R008 scope row and B, C, and D receipts

attribute_types.conversion_complete: HDF5 boolean enum over unsigned byte with exactly FALSE=0 and TRUE=1
attribute_types.all_other_attributes: scalar fixed-length UTF-8 strings whose declared byte length equals the exact expected UTF-8 value; maximum 256 bytes; compare exact encoded bytes before decoding; no variable-length heap allocation, arrays, compound types, or alternate encodings

hash_attribute_sources.generated_xml_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact B generated_xml_path bytes, independently recomputed
hash_attribute_sources.definition_sha256: SHA-256 in B definition_binding, checked against the hash-closed R008 Definition/control pack entry
hash_attribute_sources.materialization_receipt_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact canonical B receipt.json bytes
hash_attribute_sources.raw_solver_manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact canonical C raw-solver-manifest.json bytes
hash_attribute_sources.scope_receipt_sha256: SHA-256 of the frozen R008 t1-scope-design-v1 receipt bytes
hash_attribute_sources.parameter_contract_sha256: SHA-256 of the frozen R001 parameter-contract-v1 bytes

time.semantics: the complete frozen C raw-solver axis in order; exact IEEE-754 bits, beginning with positive zero and strictly increasing; no dropped, duplicated, interpolated, or synthesized frames

particle_id.semantics: strictly increasing exact fluid-ID projection derived from the hash-bound B generated XML groups

position.semantics: raw native Posd values, or exact float64 promotion of native Pos values, projected by particle_id; every selected component must be finite

velocity.semantics: raw native Vel values projected by particle_id; every selected component must be finite

density.semantics: raw native Rhop values projected by particle_id; finite and strictly positive

mass.semantics: the exact per-particle MassFluid binary64 value bound in B/C, rounded once to float32 using IEEE-754 roundTiesToEven; positive, finite, and bitwise invariant across every ID and frame; never recomputed from time-varying density

valid.dtype: HDF5 boolean enum over unsigned byte with exactly FALSE=0 and TRUE=1
valid.semantics: all true; every registered fluid ID occurs exactly once in every complete native frame

source_projection.membership_source: B materialization receipt plus generated XML, with BI4 CaseNp and CaseN* metadata
source_projection.raw_frame_identity_gate: each C frame must contain the complete uint32 ID universe [0, CaseNp) exactly once before any fluid projection; reject missing, duplicate, changed, or unknown IDs
source_projection.required_native_arrays: unique Idp:uint32, exactly one Pos:float32 or Posd:float64, Vel:float32x3, and Rhop:float32; all counts equal CaseNp
source_projection.source_recomputation: re-read each hash-bound C BI4 frame and compare time, projected position/velocity/density, and MassFluid-derived mass against the corresponding HDF5 row; exact after the schema-declared dtype conversion
source_projection.mass_binary64_gate: before float32 conversion, require the B initial MassFluid raw little-endian binary64 bytes to exactly equal the raw MassFluid bytes from every C frame; reject bit drift even if both values round to the same float32
source_projection.density_mass_distinction: Rhop is time-varying state; MassFluid is invariant particle mass. They are separate datasets with separate source semantics.

verification.table_file: open through a held no-follow descriptor; require a stable single-link regular file, exact D output-manifest size/hash, and the file-size cap
verification.full_axis: T equals the frozen complete C native axis and every table row maps one-to-one to the corresponding C frame ordinal
verification.fluid_axis: P and particle_id exactly equal the sorted fluid cohort derived from B; nonfluid IDs are excluded only after raw-universe validation
verification.frame_values: position, velocity, density, mass, and valid are independently recomputed or checked against the upstream raw frame; fail the whole case on any mismatch
